[SWS_DM_01429] SOVD method Retrieve List of All Configura- tions Provided by the Entity
⌈
If at least one SOVD configuration is configured
according to Diagnostic Extract Template[3] the Diagnostic Server instance
shall provide the SOVD method Retrieve List of All Configurations Pro-
vided by the Entity according to ASAM SOVD[2].
⌋
